text: That opening paragraph really puts the following time-lapse animation showing every nuclear explosion since 1945 in perspective: [VIDEO] One of the most fascinating things is seeing how every string of nuclear tests in Russia were quickly followed by many more detonations in the US.

story: The USSR used a nuclear charge to stop a gas well fire in 1966
text: Here's a timelapse of every nuclear explosion since 1945. It really puts into perspective just how many nukes have gone off for purposes other than to kill people. It's amazing that only two were used for violence. [VIDEO] According to the video, people have detonated 2053 nukes, and America has the dubious distinction of having detonated over 1000.

story: At the Very Least, Your Days of Eating Pacific Ocean Fish Are Over
